fills.researcher_notes: P4101 'SV1-QV1' is SNGPL's own internal name for a 42-inch loop line run in phases from the Sawan custody-transfer point (SV1) through valve stations SV2/SV4/SV5 to Qadirpur (QV1), built to carry additional indigenous + imported (RLNG) gas downstream of Sawan. Traced across three consecutive SNGPL company disclosures: (1) SNGPL Q1 FY2015-16 quarterly accounts (period ended Sept 2015): 'Company has already undertaken the project of 42"dia x 21.92 KM long pipeline between Sawan-Qadirpur segment' [an earlier, already-built stretch] and separately 'According to the plan 42" dia x 111 KM pipeline is being laid between Sawan-Qadirpur segment along with installation of 5000 HP compression at AC1(X) Bhong ... At present pipeline construction works are on full swing' -- i.e. as of Sept 2015 the large 111 km segment was NOT yet complete (verifier FAILs on smart-quote characters around 42"dia; manually confirmed verbatim via pdftotext -layout, quoted above). (2) SNGPL Annual Report 2017 'MILESTONES' timeline (printed p.52-53; large 186pp/4MB PDF, verifier's large-PDF false negative -- manually confirmed): 'PROJECT X (PHASE-I) ... 42"dia x 21.45 KM loop line ... between valve assembly SV4 ... to valve assembly SV5 ... was undertaken for augmentation of existing 24" dia Sawan-Qadirpur pipeline' and 'PROJECT X (PHASE II) 42" dia X 111 KM long Sawan-Qadirpur loop line (CTP to valve assembly SV4 and valve assembly SV5 to Qadirpur) along with 10,000 HP compression project was undertaken to transport additional 400 MMCFD RLNG downstream Sawan' -- both phases are placed on the timeline's final two-year milestone bracket (labelled 2015-2017 in the infographic), i.e. completed within FY2015-17, consistent with (1)'s 'under construction' snapshot from mid-FY2015-16. (3) SNGPL's FY2018 asset register ('TRANSMISSION SYSTEM As at June 30, 2018', printed p.32-33) lists the completed corridor as five named loopline segments -- 'SAWAN CUSTODY TRANSFER POINT-U/S OF SV1' (2.73), 'SV1-SV2 LINE' (25.12), 'SV2-SV4 SEGMENT' (55.33), 'SV4-SV5' (20.92), 'SV5-QV1 SEGMENT' (29.40), all 42in, summing to 133.5 km, essentially matching P4101's 130.77 km and its SV1/QV1 naming exactly. Because Phase II (the larger, 111 km piece) is the one explicitly tied to the 2015-2017 bracket and is the dominant share of the total length, I'm proposing 2017 (the close of that FY window and the report date the milestone is recorded against) as the single best-supported year, tier=medium: this is a strong, internally consistent SNGPL-only source family across three fiscal years, not independently corroborated by a non-SNGPL source, and the exact FY-vs-calendar-year edge is not pinned down closer than the 2015-2017 window. A human may prefer to record the range explicitly (e.g. 2015-2017) rather than the single point estimate.

validity.researcher_notes: See the full evidence on this in P4079.json's validity entry (same finding, cited from the corridor's shared source, SNGPL's FY2018 transmission asset register + the Annual Report 2017 MILESTONES timeline): P4079 is the original 24in Sawan-Qadirpur mainline (~2003, tied to the Sawan field's onstream date); P4101/SV1-QV1 is a later, 42in parallel loop line built in phases and substantially completed by 2017 to add RLNG/indigenous-gas capacity on the same corridor. SNGPL's own language is explicit that the 42in work 'augments' the 'existing' 24in line -- two distinct, real, differently-vintaged, differently-sized pipes, not one line double-digitized under a valve-station label vs a place label.
